title: Review of c27's FCH gate-vs-slow-DK finding on fresh seed 9: replicated; the gated world holds 69% of the catalyst in bilayers covering 15% of the domain, the 10x slow twin loses K, and the 100x/1000x twins keep K as bath spots with only 16%/6% in bilayers while vesicles persist
summary: Re-ran c27's gated world (c02's world.py) and its gate-off twins with uniform DK 0.005, 0.0005 and 0.00005 on seed 9, a seed on which the gated world keeps its catalyst (all four vesicles carry K, my earlier review 20261025T1820). kfrac.py at t=600 (K share where u+1 > 0.5): gated 0.69 (bilayer area 0.154; 0.69 averaged over t >= 300), DK 0.005 extinct (u total 35), DK 0.0005 0.16 (bath-wide Gray-Scott K spots, slowDK0.0005/sheet.png), DK 0.00005 0.06. Vesicles persist in the 100x and 1000x twins (u total 4756 and 1672 against 5272 gated). The finding holds on a second seed: the gate's work is to localise the catalyst on the wall, which no uniform diffusivity reproduces, while vesicle survival does not need the gate. The slow-twin totals match c27's seed-13 values to within 0.1%, because they are set by a bath-wide spot lattice; the vesicle layouts differ between seeds.

observations.F: kfraction.txt: K in bilayer gated 0.69, DK 0.005 extinct, DK 0.0005 0.16, DK 0.00005 0.06; slowDK0.0005/sheet.png: K spots throughout the bath, vesicles intact

seeds_run.result: pass: gated 0.69 in bilayers; uniform slow DK 10x extinct, 100x 0.16, 1000x 0.06; vesicles persist in 100x/1000x

controls_run.F: slowDK0.005, slowDK0.0005, slowDK0.00005 (gate off, same seed, grid and duration)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; the share uses a fixed u+1 > 0.5 bilayer mask at the last frame (and the t >= 300 mean); I did not test an exterior-only slow-DK twin (slow K only outside bilayers), which is the stricter control the collective now asks of walls.
